items.evidence: README's play command (--ticks 1 --settings s0) printed screen title and one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
play --ticks 30 --inputs 2:enter,5:shoot --frame f_play.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; file reports 800 x 480 RGBA.
Fresh folder: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 2:enter gives screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.
Settings: volume 8->9->10, more Right stays 10; ten Lefts reach 0 and stay 0; language en->es->fr, stops at fr, Left back to en; difficulty normal (default)->hard, stops; Left normal->easy, stops.

es and fr folders: title (Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir; Record/Commencer/Reglages/Quitter), settings, play (Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta; Score/Pieces/Vague 1 sur 8/Porte), paused, shop, won (Has ganado / Victoire), lost (Has perdido / Defaite) all translated; es/fr tables have every en key.
Run 1 in s3 set volume 0, French, hard; run 2 with s3 starts language fr, volume 0, difficulty hard; a fresh folder starts en, 8, normal.
Up held: guard_y 6 -> 6.1 per tick (6/s), 7.0 after 10 ticks, stops at 12; Down held from 12 reaches 0 and stays 0.
Shoot held from tick 63: bolts appear at ticks 64, 88, 112 (every 24); x step 0.2333/tick = 14/s; the bolt at 19.97 (tick 140) is gone at tick 141.
Seed 1 wave 1: 5 walkers spawned at ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 apart) at x=20 in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick = 1.5/s.

Guard at y=1.8 shoots: walker health 2->1 at tick 111 and the bolt is gone; second bolt destroys it, score 10, coins 1. A bolt from y=5 passes the lane-2 walker (bolt x 18.3 > walker 17.6, health stays 2).
Unshot walker reaches x~0 at tick 803: removed, gate 10->9, score 20 and coins 2 unchanged. Later the gate reaches 0: screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 90, Best: 90, Enter: title].
Start with easy set: gate_health 14; with hard set: 7; normal: 10.

Wave 1 cleared at tick 454: screen shop, enemies and bolts empty, state unchanged across ticks 455-468; texts Shop, Coins: 5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands 0/2 price 5, Heavy bolts 0/1 price 12, Mason 10/10 price -, Next wave.
Quick 1 (5 coins): held shoot gives bolts 4.2 apart (18 ticks); quick 2 (10 coins at shop 3): 2.8 apart (12 ticks); Enter on Quick hands at 2/2 with 18 coins left coins 18, quick 2.

Heavy bought for 12 (18->6 coins); second Enter on it left coins 6, heavy 1. After it brutes show health 6,4,2 and wave-6 walkers are never seen at health 1 (each killed by one bolt; wave 6 scored 190 = all 16 killed).
Gate 7 with 2 coins: Mason changes nothing; gate 7 with 9 coins: Mason -> gate 10, coins 5; again at 10/10: no change; gate 9 with 4 coins: Mason -> 10 (capped), coins 0.

Next wave Enter at tick 469: no enemy at tick 529, a walker at x=20 at tick 530 (60 ticks later); texts 'Wave 2 of 8'; wave 2 spawned 7 walkers 90 ticks apart; Spanish 'Oleada 1 de 8', French 'Vague 1 sur 8'.
Wave 3: 6 walkers then 4 runners, 72 ticks (1.2 s) apart; runner health 1, speed 3.0/s; wave 3 score 120 = 60 + 4x15 and 10 coins.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute: health 6, speed 1.0/s; destroyed it gives 40 points and 3 coins (wave score 120, coins +11). Brute left alone: gate 10 -> 7 (gate hit 3).
modules/work/waves.json holds walkers, runners, brutes, every per wave (matching the brief; all 8 waves played matched it); README 'Changing a wave' explains the edit.
A scripted run cleared all 8 waves with gate 10: screen won at tick 6519, score 1540 = 1340 kill points + 20x10; Enter there gives the title.
Escape at tick 30: paused, texts Paused/Resume/Title; enemy x 19.325 and bolt x 4.333 unchanged until tick 90; Enter on Resume continues from them (19.30, 4.567); Down+Enter on Title gives the title.
saved false in play, true when the shop opens (tick 455); next run with the same folder: texts Start, Continue, Settings, Quit.

After buying Quick hands and quitting, Continue opens shop wave 1, score 50, coins 0, quick 1; another save gives gate 7, coins 2, score 20, Mason 7/10. Next wave from there plays wave 2, first enemy 60 ticks later.
Start sets saved false and the next title has no Continue; won and lost both set saved false; Title from the pause in wave 2 leaves saved true and Continue opens the wave-1 shop (quick 1).
Folder with best 90 then a 1540 win: best 1540, later title 'Best: 1,540'; folder with best 1540 then a 90 loss: lost screen 'Best: 1,540', title still 1,540; won and lost screens show Best.
Two copies of a kept folder, seed 3, same script, 900 ticks: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 1 lanes 2,4,8,6,6; seed 7: 10,6,2,2,4; seed 3: 4,2,10,2,10.

Wave 8 frame (f_w8.png): grey gate at x=0, blue guard at (2,6), green walkers, tall yellow runners, large red brute and white bolts at the state's positions (40 px/unit); HUD Score 990, Coins 54, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 7.
French title frame with Reglages outlined (menu_index 1), French settings frame with 'Langue : Francais' outlined, Spanish shop frame with 'Flechas pesadas' outlined.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json (same keys); UI files use @keys; README 'Adding a language' explains copying en.json.
README has How to play, Where everything kept is kept (settings file in the --settings folder: volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save), and play/frame commands that ran as written.

defects: Start (title) and Next wave (shop) are always drawn in the bright primary style, so with focus elsewhere two entries look highlighted; the focused entry is marked only by an outline.
README says only that a windowed player's kept data is in 'a folder of their own, per user' and does not name the path.
Before Start the report gives wave 0 and gate_health 0 (README notes this).
